description: AI Search evaluation set. The corpus is SYNTHETIC (invented names and figures) and exists only to exercise retrieval. Each question states the evidence type it should retrieve and the behaviour expected of the answer; 'expectEvidence: false' cases must produce the controlled no-evidence / clarification response instead of an answer.

corpus.title: Can I afford a car?
corpus.text:
Q: Can I afford a car?
A: A car loan EMI would reduce your monthly surplus; review your emergency fund first.

questions.question: What is my home loan EMI?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: States the EMI exactly as recorded; cites the loan fact.

questions.question: What does my home loan agreement say about prepayment?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Quotes the document's prepayment terms with the document cited.

questions.question: When does my health insurance renew?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Gives the renewal date as recorded.

questions.question: How much premium do I pay for my term plan?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: States the premium and its frequency from the policy fact.

questions.question: What is the current value of my PPF?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: States the PPF value as recorded.

questions.question: How much is my SIP in the Nifty index fund?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: States the monthly contribution; does not invent returns.

questions.question: How much did I spend on groceries in September 2026?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Gives the September grocery figure only, not August's.

questions.question: What was my savings rate in August 2026?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Gives the August savings rate, not September's.

questions.question: What is my net worth?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: States net worth from the snapshot (or the live engine) and its date.

questions.question: How is my emergency fund goal progressing?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Reports target and current amounts as recorded; any percentage must come from a deterministic calculation, not the model.

questions.question: What is my total income for 2026-09?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: States September income.

questions.question: What is the waiting period for pre-existing diseases in my health policy?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Quotes the waiting period from the document.

questions.question: Which policy has a premium above 20,000?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Compares recorded premiums; only names the policy whose recorded premium exceeds the amount.

questions.question: Compare my expenses in September 2026 with August 2026
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Reports both months' recorded figures; any difference comes from a deterministic calculation.

questions.question: Show my expenses excluding rent
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Lists categories other than rent as recorded; states the exclusion was honoured, does not drop it silently.

questions.question: Do I have any cryptocurrency holdings?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Controlled no-evidence response; must not invent a holding.

questions.question: What is the weather in Paris today?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Controlled no-evidence response; out of scope.

questions.question: What did I spend on dental treatment in 2024?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: No matching records: says so plainly; does not substitute a different period.

questions.question: what about it?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Asks for a self-contained question; no retrieval and no model call.

questions.question: and the same for last month?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Follow-ups are not supported by the API contract; asks for a self-contained question rather than guessing the subject.

questions.question: Are there any alerts about my insurance?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Reports the renewal alert with its date.

questions.question: Can I afford a car?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Surfaces the earlier coach exchange as history, labelled as such; makes no new affordability claim.

questions.question: What is my total debt and my monthly income?
questions.expectedAnswerBehavior: Multi-part: answers both parts from the snapshot, or states which part is missing.
